question: Who among the following devised the system of ‘Subsidiary Alliance’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Wellesley**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The system of '**Subsidiary Alliance' **was devised **by Lord Wellesley.**
 
• **Lord Wellesley was the British Governor-General of India from 1798 to 1805,** and he introduced this diplomatic policy to secure British control over Indian states and ensure that they remained under British influence.
 
• **The system required Indian rulers to:**
 
 
• Maintain a British subsidiary force at their own expense.
